description: Arrêts, horaires et circuits des lignes Oleane (GTFS - Les Sables d'Olonne Agglomération) is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Oléane. Lignes, arrêts et horaires théorique du réseau Oléane au format GTFS. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Car, Bus. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
